bio: An engaging husband-and-wife team bring their natural charm to this intimate Japanese restaurant that relocated from Wrocław towards the end of 2022. The L-shaped counter seats just eight guests, who are encouraged to interact as the omakase menu unfolds. Largely imported produce is utilised in familiar dishes such as tuna temaki, chawanmushi and an array of nigiri. Japanese whiskies and a choice of sakes complete the memorable experience....
